t: 2031 — First material hulls product ships at scale: solid electrolytes
title: 2031 — First material hulls product ships at scale: solid electrolytes
definition: 2031 milestone on the Solid-State Battery Materials roadmap.
description:
First material hulls product ships at scale: solid electrolytes synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the solid electrolytes results have to replicate outside the lab, material logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and interface stability operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed solid electrolytes demonstrations, material logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting interface stability uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

definition: Estimates Solid-State Battery Materials readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Solid-State Battery Materials components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a material hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Solid-State Battery Materials Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Solid-State Battery Materials operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Solid-State Battery Materials installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 19488 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where solid electrolytes monitoring, material logistics redundancy, or interface stability maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Solid-State Battery Materials Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Solid-State Battery Materials: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Solid-State Battery Materials — materials for solid-state batteries.

Phase 1 — Prove (solid electrolytes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (material logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (interface stability): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (gigafactories): material hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and batteries-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
